control_flow: stopAtWall: if the right obstacle sensor sees something, turn right 90°; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Stop when the robot reaches a wall.

decision_points.condition: the right obstacle sensor sees an obstacle, wall or the floor's edge less than 3 cm ahead

branches.outcome: the right sensor sees something: the robot turns right 90°
the right sensor sees nothing: it calls followLine
the line tracker sees black: it curves left
the line tracker does not see black: it curves right

scenarios.coded_response: It turns right 90° at 30 % and goes on; it has no block that stops the robot.

uncertainties: You said stop at the wall, but the program has no stop block: it turns right 90° when the right obstacle sensor sees something.
The program reads only the right obstacle sensor, not the front one, and the line tracker decides the rest.
On a plain floor it turns right in a curve, so a world needs a line wherever the robot should follow one.
